title: Joint Rustaveli-DAAD-fellowship programme
summary: Research grants for doctoral candidates and postdocs from Georgia to conduct research visits at higher education or research institutions in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Very well-qualified doctoral candidates and postdocs (postdoc track is excluded from student award focus, but included in mixed scheme per instructions).

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are eligible implicitly as no subject restrictions are mentioned.

institutions.notes: State or state-recognised institutions of higher education or non-university research institutes in Germany.

residence.notes: Applicants must work at or be affiliated to a university or institute of higher education in their home country.

mandatory.text: Applicants must work at a university or institute of higher education (Post-Docs) or be affiliated to a university or institute of higher education (doctoral candidates) in their home country.
The research project must be coordinated with an academic host institute in Germany and a workplace must be provided.

funding.description: Young researchers: Monthly scholarship payment of 2,150 euros plus contribution towards travel expenses and health insurance coverage. Doctoral candidates: Monthly scholarship payment of 1,400 euros plus contributions towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover, and contribution towards travel expenses.
funding.duration: Young researchers 2-6 months; Doctoral candidates 3 months or 6 months (for binational doctoral degrees)

application_rounds.notes: The selection is expected to take place in May 2026.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
Comprehensive statement about research project (max. 4 pages)
Time schedule and itinerary (host institutes / academic hosts) of the planned research stay
Letter from host confirming academic cooperation
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects
German or English translations of documents submitted in the national language
Copy of last academic qualification; confirmation of their doctoral degree for doctoral candidates
All university certificates on all annual examinations with individual grade(s), incl. explanation of grading system
One recent letter of recommendation from a university teacher

steps.text: Request recommendation form and have it completed by a university teacher.
Fill out the application form and upload the application documents in PDF format to the portal.

sources.title: Joint Rustaveli-DAAD-fellowship programme - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: International doctoral candidates and postdocs receive funding for research visits physically in Germany.
